claim_boundary: Train-only deterministic corruption amendment frozen before the first multimodal optimization update. It defines masked predicted-structure reconstruction and modality dropout without reading PINDER validation/test rows or any downstream benchmark metric.

corruption.deterministic_ranking: SHA-256(seed, scope, residue_index); no ambient RNG state
corruption.masked_residue_rule: For each observed, non-dropped chain, select max(1, ceil(0.15 * observed_residues)) residues by deterministic SHA-256 rank; replace 3Di by MASK and continuous features by zero.
reconstruction_targets: original observed 3Di class at masked residues
original 17D continuous feature vector at masked residues
corruption.special_and_missing_positions: Never selected as reconstruction targets and always carry missing token plus zero continuous features.

rationale.discovery_stage: implementation before any multimodal optimization update
